remarks: Nestled in the highly sought-after Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk, this charming split-level home offers the perfect blend of modern updates and classic comfort. Boasting three well-sized bedrooms and two full baths, this residence has been thoughtfully updated with refinished hardwood floors and a fresh coat of paint, giving the home a bright, welcoming feel. A brand-new roof installed within the last two years ensures peace of mind for years to come.  The finished lower level provides extra living space, perfect for a family room or home office, and features a cozy fireplace-ideal for relaxing on chilly evenings. Step outside to enjoy the large backyard, perfect for outdoor entertaining, gardening, or just unwinding in your own private retreat.  Located within walking distance to Cranbury Plaza, you'll have easy access to a grocery store, Chinese food, pizza, and a liquor store-making everyday convenience just steps away. Experience all that Cranbury has to offer, one of Norwalk's most coveted neighborhoods known for its friendly community and suburban charm.  Don't miss your chance to make this updated, move-in ready home yours
